source: After leaving the manor, disguising himself, and losing at least two people who followed him after exiting the gate of the Silvercrest manor, Sam went around the city, periodically changing his looks, doing odd things, and walking in circles for a while.
target: Postquam manerium reliquit, se celans, et saltem duos homines qui eum postquam portam manerii Silvercrest transegerunt amisit, Sam per urbem vagatus est, vultum suum interdum mutans, res insolitas faciens, atque aliquantisper circulos ambulans.

source: Then, when he was sure that nobody was following him anymore, he shed his latest disguise, returned to his original look, pocketing the Chameleon Mask, Sam began to whistle gently and began walking towards one of the general shops.
target: Deinde, cum certus esset neminem eum amplius sequi, novissimam subditionem abdidit, ad aspectum suum originarium revertere, et "Chameleon Mask" in sinum recondendo, Sam leniter sibilare coepit atque ad unam tabernam generalem ambulare incipiebat.

source: The information provided by the Lord was somewhat vague, with the only thing being known about the Chalice, that it was hidden in one of the old ironwood forests around the city.
target: Notitia a Domino data aliquantum vaga erat, cum sola res notam de Calice esset – id sciebat quod in una ex antiquis silvis ligni ferrarii circa urbem celatum esset.

source: This kinda of made sense, but also made his job much harder as all ancient groves of trees were either heavily guarded or so hidden, nobody knew where they were.
target: Id sensum aliquatenus habebat, sed negotium eius etiam multo arduiorem faciebat, quoniam omnia veterana nemora arborum vel valde vigilabantur vel tam occultata erant ut nemo sciret ubi essent.

source: And if that wasn’t enough, Lord Silvercrest was sure that his enemies also knew that the only thing capable of saving his wife was the Chalice so they would either hinder him or search for the Chalice themselves.
target: Et si id non sufficeret, Dominus Silvercrest certo credebat hostes suos etiam novisse unam tantum rem quae uxorem servare posset – id est, Calicem – itaque aut eum impedirent aut ipsi Calicem quaererent.

source: Thankfully, there was a silver lining to the story.
target: Felix tamen, in fabula lumen argenteum apparuit.

source: Sadly, it wasn’t that he knew exactly where the artifact was.
target: Infeliciter, non exacte sciebat ubi artefactum esset.

source: This was a completely unknown quest to him, as the other Sam only knew about the probable after‐effects of the quest.
target: Hoc iter plane ignotum ei fuit, quoniam alter Sam solum de probabilibus effectibus post expeditionem sciret.

source: But the other Sam spent a lot of time in Ironwood, and by the time he arrived in the city, the guilds had already explored big parts of the area and guides were available for cheap.
target: Sed alter Sam multum temporis in Ironwood egit, et tempore quo in urbem pervenit, gildae iam magnam partem regionis exploraverant et duces vili pretio praesto erant.

source: And those guides were currently rattling around in his head, ready to be used.
target: Et hi duces iam in mente eius vagabant, parati ad usum operandum.

source: “Let us see what will happen!” he thought as he continued his preparations.
target: „Videamus quid eveniat!” cogitavit, dum parationes suas pergebat.

source: It was getting easier to handle, but logging out still left him a little confused and with a little uncontrollable body.
target: Rem tractare facilius videbatur, sed exitus sessionis eum paulum confusum reliquebat atque corpus eius aliquantulum ingovernabile.

source: Thankfully, the exercises he had been doing, and knowing about the issue and how it was handled in the future made it so that Sam just did a few stretching exercises and other movements, and the confusion was gone and his appendages were back under his control.
target: Gratia exercitationum quas exerciebat atque cognitione quaestionis necnon quomodo ea postea tractata essent, Sam paucis exercitationibus distensionis et aliorum motuum uti solebat, et confusio evanuit atque membra sua rursus sub imperio eius erant.

source: After going through his usual log-out routine, he sat down in front of his computer dressed in fresh clothing, hair still a little bit damp.
target: Postquam solitam sessionis clausuram perrexerat, ante computatrum suum sedebat, vestimentis recentibus indutus, capillis adhuc paulum umidis.

source: He checked his emails and other assorted notifications, pointedly ignoring anything related to Shadowland.
target: Epistulas electronicās et alias notificationes varias inspexit, neglegens omnia quae ad Shadowland pertinere videbantur.

source: He knew what it was mostly about, but first, he wanted to deal with the general stuff.
target: Sciebat quid plerumque conserneret, sed primo voluit de rebus universalibus agere.

source: A quick check showed him that the official stuff was doing okay.
target: Celeris inspectio ei ostendit res officiales satis bene versari.

source: His shares in Future Unknown were doing really well, as well as several other investments in companies that would become bigger and more profitable with the rise of the game.
target: Partes eius in Future Unknown optime se gerebant, sicut et plura alia pecuniaria in societatibus quae cum ludorum ortu maiorem et lucrativam fieri promissae erant.

source: Another check at the official site showed that the timeline hadn’t deviated yet, as they hadn’t posted anything that the other Sam hadn’t seen.
target: Alia inspectio in situ officiali ostendit chronologiam nondum deviatam, cum nihil postatum esset quod alter Sam non viderat.

source: There were the usual video compilations of the funny, sad and awesome moments, and he spent a little time watching those, trying to spot people that would be important, but sadly the company did a good job in anonymizing the player without decreasing the quality of the videos.
target: Erat consueta compilatio video momentorum iocularium, maerorum, et praeclarorum, et ille parum temporis ea inspiciens consumpsit, conans agnoscere eos qui magni momenti essent, sed infeliciter societas pulchre operam dedit ad lusorem anonymum reddendum sine qualitatem videoorum minuenda.

source: There were even a few scenes of Lucky in action in one of the compilations…
target: Etiam paucae scaenae de Lucky in actu in una ex compilationibus adhibitae erant…

source: Sam made sure to download that one.
target: Sam curavit ut illud dempsisset.

source: Then, he turned his attention to the forums.
target: Deinde, animum ad fora convertebat.

source: Aside from the local sections that were focused on the conflicts and actions of certain towns, the main page of the game’s forum was occupied with the Life of Blood skill.
target: Praeter sectiones locales, quarum in contentiones et actiones certarum urbium versabantur, pagina principalis fori ludi occupabatur per artem vitae sanguinis.

source: It was a good skill. Hell, it was an excellent skill. Ten percent base health regeneration for practically free, plus the subskill at the tenth level? It was basically a godly skill.
target: Ars bona erat. En, ars praeclara erat. Decem centesimae regenerationis salutis ex fundamento fere gratis, atque subperitia ad decimum gradum—in summa, ars quasi divina erat.

source: If it weren’t for that minuscule drawback…
target: Nisi ob illum levissimum incommodum…

source: As Sam scrolled through the forums, reading people overreacting or praising the skill, while several people were calling for nerfing it, if not outright banning it.
target: Dum Sam per fora delabatur, legens homines aut artem nimis laudantes aut vehementer criticantes, dum plures eam attenuare, si non omnino interdicere, postulabant.

source: But the developers were silent. Probably because they knew about the blood magic aspect.
target: Sed programmatores silent erant. Forsitan quia de sanguinea magica notitiam habebant.

source: Then, as Sam read another jealousy‐filled rant, he had a wicked idea.
target: Deinde, dum Sam aliam invidiae plenum orationem legebat, malitiosam ideam concipiebat.

source: Grinning, ear to ear, he switched over to the Shadowland website, ignored all the requests for more Life of Blood skill books, and began typing.
target: Subridente a fronte usque ad auribus, ad situm Shadowland convertit, neglexit omnes petitiones pro libris additis artis “Vitae Sanguinis” et scribere coepit.

source: It was a simple message.
target: Erat nuntius simplex.

source: “Trolls, you idiots.”
target: “Trolli, stulti estis.”

source: Under it, he added a few Wiki-like articles about the mythology of trolls, highlighting and quoting the parts about their superior regeneration and blood, then set the price of viewing the post the lowest amount possible.
target: Sub eo, addidit nonnullos articulos similes Wiki de mythologia trollorum, partes de eorum praestante regeneratione et sanguine extollens et citans, deinde pretium ad legendum nuntium minimum possibile constituit.

source: He added a few tags, just to make sure even more people saw it, then clicked on the upload button, leaned back in his chair, and watched as the chaos unfolded.
target: Addidit nonnullas titulos (tags) ut certior fieret plures id viderent, deinde puga “upload” premens, in sella recubavit, et spectavit dum chaos evoluta esset.

source: For a moment nothing happened, then as people realized that he had posted, they began to flock to his post, while happily watching as the viewer counter ticked up.
target: Per momentum nihil accidit, deinde, cum homines intellexerunt eum postatum esse, ad post eius concurrere coeperunt, laeti spectantes dum numerus spectatorum augebat.

source: It was just the cherry on the top that he got paid for it.
target: Hoc erat quasi cerasum in summo, quod pro eo remuneratus est.

source: He gleefully read the responses.
target: Sam laetus responsa legebat.

source: “LazyPhoenix thx as always, you r the bro!”
target: “LazyPhoenix, gratias ut semper, tu es fratrem!”

source: “As always, quality content. Thanks!”
target: “Ut semper, contentum optimae qualitatis; gratias!”

source: “Thanks, bro, this will allow us to dominate the area! MightyWolves Go!”
target: “Gratias, fratrem, hoc nobis sinet regionem dominari! MightyWolves, procedite!”

source: “MightyWolves suck! RagingDucks are the best!”
target: “MightyWolves male sunt! RagingDucks optimi sunt!”

source: And so on…
target: Et cetera…

source: Eventually, as with all forum threads, it devolved into name‐calling and other nice things, so the mods intervened and locked the thread, while Sam just cackled in his apartment, watching the counter tick up faster and faster.
target: Denique, sicut in omnibus discussionibus fororum, sermo in iniurias nominativas ac alias leves res degeneravit, itaque moderatores intervenere et thread clauderunt, dum Sam in domo sua cachinnans numerum spectatorum celeriter ascendere spectabat.

source: He made a good chunk of money and even hastened the approach of the Blood Dance… Probably.
target: Magnam pecuniae portionem consecutus est atque etiam adventum Saltationis Sanguinis festinavit… Probabiliter.

source: But at least most people would be concentrating on hunting down the trolls to make as much money as possible.
target: Sed saltem plerique homines intendebant trollos venari, ut pecuniam quam maxime comparare possent.

source: And wouldn’t you know? Ironwood had several areas around it, especially in the mountains, that contained trolls.
target: Et nonne scies? Ironwood complura spatia circa se habebat, praesertim in montibus, ubi trolli inerat.

source: “A perfect distraction for my mission…”
target: "Perfecta distractio pro mea missione…

source: Ironwood City was abuzz around him as he collected the necessary supplies for his quest.
target: Urbs Ironwood circa eum alacriter vibrabat, dum necessaria subsidia pro expeditione sua collegit.

source: He eyed as the proto‐guilds, mercenary bands, gaming groups and other collections of greedy players moved around him, tense, ready to pounce at the slightest provocation.
target: Ille animadvertit proto‐gildas, manipulorum mercenariorum, coetus ludicros et alias aggregationes avarorum lusorum circa se versari, tensi et parati ad minima quidem provocatione impetum dare.

source: While he was enjoying a nice dinner in a restaurant near his home, a guild found the trolls around Ironwood.
target: Dum cenam iucundam in caupona prope domum suam fruebatur, una gilda trollos circa Ironwood detexit.

source: There was a brief clash with two other guilds as the information naturally was leaked immediately.
target: Erat brevis congressus cum duabus aliarum gildarum, cum notitia statim divulgata esset.

source: As of now, there was an uneasy truce as the guilds geared up for a fight.
target: Nunc, inter gildas, pax incommoda exstabat, cum gildae ad certamen praeparabantur.

source: And Sam couldn’t be happier.
target: Sam non poterat laetior esse.

source: He already saw several groups of soldiers belonging to the noble families that the Lord of Silvercrest named as their enemies leave the city, heading, presumably, to support a group that earned that privilege.
target: Iam vidit complura manipula militum ex familiaribus nobilibus, quos Dominus Silvercrest hostibus suis designavit, urbem exire, fortasse ut coetum sustinerent qui illud honorem adeptus esset.

source: Or to take the troll hunting ground for themselves. One can never know…
target: Vel ut ipsi terram venandi trollorum sibi vindicent. Quid futurum sit, nemo scit…

source: And while the chaos was brewing around him, he stocked up his perishables, had his armor and weapon repaired, got some potions, and copied the local and other maps he gathered into his grimoire.
target: Dum chaos circa eum bulliebat, cibaria pereuntia congregavit, armum telumque reparavit, potiones acceperat, et tabulas locales aliasque quas collegisset in grimoario suo consignavit.

source: Standing in the middle of his room he looked at the collected items, making notes, trying to figure out if he missed something while Lucky lazily lay on the bed, watching him with sparkling eyes.
target: Stans in media camera sua, res collectas inspiciens, notas faciens, quaerens utrum quid omitteret, dum Lucky languide in lecto iacebat et eum oculis micantibus contemplabat.

source: After half an hour of internal debate, he finally decided that he had everything he needed, so he put everything away into his inventory and bags of holding.
target: Post dimidium horae disputationum internarum, tandem decrevit se omnia habere necessaria, itaque ea in inventario et sacculis tenendi recondidit.

source: Turning to Lucky, he spoke up softly.
target: Conversus ad Lucky, leniter locutus est.

source: “Are you ready, Lucky?”
target: “Paratus es, Lucky?”

source: His answer was an eager bark.
target: Responsum eius fuit latratus alacer.

source: “All right. Then hop into my shadow and we can go!”
target: “Bene. Ergo, in umbram meam sali et eamus!”

source: The wolf nodded, then slowly stood up and rather comically jumped into the air and dived headfirst into his shadow.
target: Lupus annuit, deinde lente surrexit, et quasi comice in aethera salit atque capite primum in umbram suam immergit.

source: Which was followed by a small notification window.
target: Quae postea parva fenestra notificationum apparuit.

source: [Thanks to the growing connection between you and your spirit companion, Spirit Link has reached Level 7!]
target: [Gratias nexui crescens inter te et spiritum comitem, Spirit Link ad Gradum VII pervenit!]

source: Smiling silently, Sam dismissed the window, and with determined steps left the room.
target: Sam, silentio subridente, fenestram reiecit, et cum passibus firmatis conclave reliquit.

source: His first step was to find an old man.
target: Primum, senem invenire constituit.

source: At least according to the Lord of Silvercrest, the old man he found was an old ranger that used to walk the hidden woods around the city of Ironwood.
target: Saltem, secundum Dominum Silvercrest, senex quem invenit erat quondam custos silvarum, qui in silvis occultis circa urbem Ironwood ambulabat.

source: The lord managed to get an approximate location at the eastern part of the town, but the remaining legwork was left to Sam.
target: Dominus locum approximatum in parte orientali oppidi assecutus erat, sed reliqua opera itineris Sam relinquuntur.

source: Sam could have started to canvass the area, but why work hard when there was an easy way?
target: Sam regionem perlustrare poterat, sed cur laborare, cum via facilis exsisteret?

source: He simply donned a dark cloak, used the Chameleon Mask to change his looks, this time into a pretty blonde and sought out one of the darker areas of the city, where crime was still the king.
target: Ille simpliciter pallium obscurum induit, "Chameleon Mask" usus est ut speciem suam mutaret, hoc tempore in faciem decorae flavae, atque unam ex partibus obscurioribus urbis quaesivit, ubi crimen adhuc dominabat.

source: Not as blatantly as in many seaside cities, but there was definitely a stench in the air that told him that not everything was alright in the area.
target: Non tam manifeste quam in multis urbibus maritimis, sed fetor in aere certe indicabat eum non omnia in regione esse recta.

source: Even the mana in the air was tainted a minuscule amount with darkness.
target: Etiam mana in aere parvo quantitate obscuritate tinctum erat.

source: He purposefully strode forward, not too fast, or too slow, just with enough speed to show that he knew where he was going.
target: Proposito animo procedebat, neque nimis celeriter neque tardius, sed satis impetu ut ostenderet se scire quo ire.

source: And when he spotted what he was looking for, he slowed down and then stopped.
target: Et cum id quod quaerebat conspexit, tardavit et deinde sistit.

source: Turning towards a small alley, he activated his defensive skill just in case and called out.
target: Ad parvum angiportum convertens, artem defensionis suam ut cautelam activavit et exclamavit.

source: “Hey kid, want to make some money?”
target: “Heus, puer, vis pecuniam facere?”

source: For a moment there was no reply or even movement in the alley, but then a small voice, hesitant but with a hidden spine, answered.
target: Per momentum nec responsum nec motus in angiporto fuit, sed deinde parva vox, dubia sed cum animi fortitudine latente, respondit.

source: “Wat’chu want?”
target: “Quid vis?”

source: Sam, knowing the rules, instead of answering just raised a hand that held one lone silver coin.
target: Sam, regulas sciens, pro respondiendo manum attollit, quae unum solum nummum argenteum tenebat.

source: Thanks to his somewhat advanced stats he managed to hear a small gasp from the shadows enveloping the alley.
target: Propter statuta aliquantum provecta, parvum suspirium e umbris angiporti circumfugientibus audire potuit.

source: “Looking for a man.”
target: “Virum quaerens.”

source: “Name?”
target: “Nomen?”

source: “No name. A ranger. Old.”
target: “Nullum nomen. Explorator. Senex.”

source: There was another silence.
target: Fuit iterum silentium.

source: He added another silver to his hand.
target: Illi addidit alterum nummum argenteum in manum.

source: “Might kno’ some-some…”
target: “Fortasse scit aliquid…”

source: Sam simply nodded.
target: Sam simpliciter annuit.

source: “Five now, ten if they are who I’m looking for.”
target: “Quinque nunc, decem si sunt illi quos quaero.”

source: He had no need to negotiate here. He had all the money he wanted, so why not make use of it?
target: Non oportuit eum hic negoceari. Omnem pecuniam optatam habebat, ergo cur non ea adhiberet?

source: There was a flurry of sounds in the alley, and then, hesitantly, a dirty-haired head belonging to a young urchin poked their head out.
target: In angiporto tumultus sonorum ortus est, et deinde, dubito, caput crinite sordido iuvenis vagabundi emersit.

source: Sam honestly couldn’t tell if they were a girl or a boy…
target: Sam vere nesciebat utrum esset puella an puer…

source: The look on the face of the kid was pretty serious.
target: Vultus in facie pueri valde gravis erat.

source: Sam could see the light of greed in their eyes.
target: Sam lucem avaritiae in oculis eorum perspiciebat.

source: He just snorted and nodded.
target: Ille tantum sputavit atque annuit.

source: He wasn’t feeling pity for them, as he knew from his inherited memories that kids like these dressed up as street urchins to make money from clueless people.
target: Non miserebat illos, nam ex memoria hereditate sciebat pueros tales se induisse ut mendicos, ad pecuniam ab insipientibus capiendam.

source: They had homes, were fed, and were surprisingly well educated.
target: Habebant domos, saturabantur, et mirum in modum bene eruditi erant.

source: Mostly to be able to con even more people, the little monsters.
target: Praecipue ut etiam plures deciperent, parvuli monstra.

source: And surprisingly, every city had one of these child organizations.
target: Et mirum in modum, omnis urbs unam huiusmodi organizationem puerilem habebat.

source: The prevailing theory was that the developers didn’t want to show starving kids in a game…
target: Praevalens theoria fuit, quod programmatores noluerunt pueros esurientes in ludo ostendere…

source: “Ya swear, mistah?”
target: “Iurabis, domine?”

source: “Drop the horrible accent and I will raise it to eleven,” Sam replied dryly.
target: “Abice accentum foedum, et illud ad undecimum elevabo,” respondit Sam aride.

source: The kid didn’t even blink.
target: Puer neque palpebra commovit.

source: “Of course, mister!” replying with an innocent looking smile and a glint in their eyes.
target: “Certe, domine!” respondit, cum risu innocenti et fulgore in oculis.

source: Sam snorted. “Show me.”
target: Sam sputavit. “Ostende mihi.”

source: “Yes, mister. Follow me, I’ll show the way to Old Marak!”
target: “Ita, domine. Sequere me, viam ad Vetus Marak ostendam!”

source: Nodding silently, he threw the five coins at the kid, who caught them, and they instantly vanished into their rags.
target: Silenter annuens, quinque nummos puero iacuit, qui eos ceperat, et statim in vestimentis suis evanuerunt.

source: The kid nodded, and they began walking with Sam following after the excitable kid.
target: Puer annuit, et ambulare coeperunt, cum Sam puerum excitatum sequens.

source: “Maybe they are not even kids, but fey…” he thought as he went over what he knew about the KidConOrg as the forums called them.
target: “Forsitan illi non pueri quidem sint, sed fey…” cogitavit, dum rem de KidConOrg, sicut fora eos nominabant, recolens.

source: “Making deals, tricking people, showing up everywhere and just altogether being mischievous…hmmm, should I?”
target: Negotia faciendi, homines decipiendi, ubique apparendi atque omnino facinorosus esse… hmmm, debeam?

source: They were in another dark part of the city, walking by dilapidated houses, old shops and generally areas that had a serious need for a facelift.
target: In alia parte obscura urbis versabantur, ambulantes iuxta domos dilapidatas, tabernas antiquas et regiones quae renovationem sincere exigebant.

source: While the kid excitedly led him through the streets and alleys of the darker side of Ironwood, he couldn’t help but notice that they were somewhat walking in a circle.
target: Dum puer eum excitatus per vias et angiportos partis obscurioris Ironwood ducebat, non potuit non animadvertisse eum paulo in circulo ambulare.

source: “Kid!”
target: “Puer!”

source: The little menace turned around, and he could see in their eyes that they were trying not to laugh.
target: Parvus vexator se vertit, et in oculis eius videbat eos conari non ridere.

source: “Yes, mister? Whatever is the issue?”
target: “Ita, domine? Quid est problema?”

source: Sam couldn’t help but snort again.
target: Sam iterum sputavit.

source: “I thought fey tended to keep to their deals…” he said, finally taking a stab in the dark.
target: “Putabam fey pacta sua tueri…” inquit, postremo in obscuro conamine incipiens.

source: For a moment, it was as if time froze, and then the smile on the kid’s face grew into a disproportional size.
target: Ad momentum, quasi tempus congelatum esset, et deinde risus in facie pueri ad ingentem dimensionem crevit.

source: He couldn’t help but shudder a little.
target: Non potuit nisi paulum tremere.

source: “We do,” came the reply, though instead of the squeaky voice of a child, it was an eerie and echo‑y voice.
target: “Facimus,” inquit, sed non voce stridula pueri, sed voce terribiliter resonante.

source: “Then why are we going in circles?”
target: “Cur ergo in circulos ambulamus?”

source: The fey in the kid’s body just shrugged, the freaky smile still on their face.
target: Fey, in corpore pueri, tantum umeros sublatit, cum risus insolitus in vultu eius adhuc maneret.

source: “You were being followed, now you aren’t.”
target: “Te secuti erant, nunc autem non sunt.”

source: “And you’re helping me. Why?”
target: “Atque me adiuvas. Cur?”

source: “I’m not helping you. I’m helping the city. This is where I store my stuff. I would like if it stayed as it is,” came the clipped reply.
target: “Non te adiuvo; urbem adiuvo. Hic res meas condō. Velim ut ita maneat,” inquit breviter.

source: Sam thought about it for a second, and in the end, he had to agree with the kid.
target: Sam de hoc per momentum cogitavit, et denique cum puero consentire debuit.

source: “That makes sense,” with that he motioned for the fey to continue towards their goal, but the kid didn’t move an inch.
target: “Id sensum facit,” inquit, et fey ad propositum pergredi iussit, sed puer ne quanti quidem passus movebat.

source: “Ah, ah, ah! You asked a question! And there are no freebies here!”
target: “Ah, ah, ah! Quaestionem posuisti! Et hic nulla gratuita sunt!”

source: He cursed internally, while also making a note to read up on the rules of the fey. But he didn’t reply, refusing to acknowledge his ‘debt’.
target: Intus maledixit atque simul notam fecit ut de regulis fey perlegeret; sed non respondit, recusans agnoscere debitum suum.

source: The smile, as if possible, got even wider on the kid’s face.
target: Risus in facie pueri, quasi amplius fieri posset, etiam latius factus est.

source: “How about a question for a question?”
target: “Quid de quaestione pro quaestione?”

source: Sam nodded in agreement.
target: Sam annuit in consensu.

source: “Excellent! My question is as follows: How did you know?”
target: “Optime! Quaestio mea est: Quomodo cognovisti?”

source: He almost chuckled at the question.
target: Paene risit ex quaestione.

source: “No street urchin behaves like you. Fey are notorious for making deals. So, I made an educated guess. You just confirmed it,” he answered with a smirk.
target: “Nullus mendiculus in via se gerit ut tu. Fey noti sunt ob pacta facienda; ergo conieci, et nunc id confirmasti,” respondit cum subridente.

source: The eyes on the kid went round in surprise, but then the kid flashed him a smile that contained more teeth than what was possible, and once again between two blinks, the dirty street urchin was back before him without the creepy smile.
target: Oculi pueri in stupefactione circumvolaverunt, sed deinde puer ei subripuit risum, qui plura dentes continebat quam fieri poterat, et post duas contractiones palpebrarum, mendiculus sordidus viae ante eum apparuit sine risu terribili.

source: “Let’s continue our journey, good sir!” they spoke up as if the previous discussion hadn’t happened.
target: “Pergamus iter nostrum, bone domine!” iniecerunt, quasi prior disputatio non fuisset.

source: Sam looked around, but somehow nobody walked by or showed up while they had their conversation.
target: Sam circumspiciebat, sed nullo modo aliquis praeterebat aut apparebat dum sermonem agebantur.

source: He shuddered again, and while walking behind the kid, he berated himself for being careless.
target: Iterum tremuit, et dum puerum sequebat, se ipse reprobatum habuit propter negligentiam.

source: That could have gone worse…
target: Hoc peius evenire poterat…

source: After a few minutes, they finally arrived at a surprisingly nice building.
target: Post paucos minuta, tandem ad aedificium mirum iucundum pervenerunt.

source: The kid stopped before the door, then turned towards him with a hand held out, waiting for their pay.
target: Puer ante ostium sistit, deinde ad eum convertit atque manum protulit, mercedem exspectans.

source: “Are you sure?”
target: “Certus es?”

source: “Yes, sir. The man you are looking for is inside.”
target: “Ita, domine. Vir quem quaeris intus est.”

source: “Good.”
target: “Bene.”

source: He pulled out the promised six silver and placed it gently in the kid’s hand.
target: Se promissos sex nummos argenteos eduxit et leniter in manu pueri posuit.

source: However, when he pulled back his hand, one coin seemed to be stuck to his skin.
target: Attamen, cum manum retraxit, unus nummus quasi ad cutem eius adhaeret.

source: As he stared at it curiously, the kid spoke up.
target: Dum illud curiosus intuens erat, puer locutus est.

source: “A little memory for our first meeting…”
target: “Parva memoria pro nostra prima congressione…”

source: He looked at the coin, which, instead of the seal of the kingdom, now was totally unadorned, except for a simple butterfly symbol.
target: Aspiciens nummum, qui pro sigillo regni nunc omnino inornatus erat, nisi simplici symbolo papilionis.

source: He looked up, but the kid was gone.
target: Elevavit oculos, sed puer evanuerat.

source: Instead, he was greeted by several notifications.
target: Pro eo, varias notificationes eum excipiebant.

source: [Congratulations, you figured out the secret identity of a Fey! You may choose to gain 1 WIS and lose 1 LUK, or gain 1 LUK and lose 1 WIS!]
target: [Gratulations, secretam identitatem Fey perspexisti! Potes eligere ut 1 WIS accipias et 1 LUK amittas, aut 1 LUK accipias et 1 WIS amittas!]

source: Sam stared at the screen for a moment, then spoke up.
target: Sam per momentum ad scrinium intuebatur, deinde locutus est.

source: “I choose neither.”
target: “Utrumque non eligam.”

source: There was a moment of silence, and another screen popped up.
target: Fuit momentum silentii, et iterum scrinium apparuit.

source: [Congratulations, you made a smart decision! You gain +1 PER!]
target: [Gratulations, sapienter decrevist! Accipis +1 PER!]

source: Nodding proudly, he continued to read.
target: Superbus annuens, continuavit legere.

source: [You received a Token of Friendship from a Fey!]
target: [Accepisti Tessera Amicitiae a Fey!]

source: [It is up to you to decide if it is a good thing or a bad thing!]
target: [In te est decernere utrum id bonum sit aut malum!]

source: [Token of Friendship (Fey): A coin bearing the mark of the fey. Can be exchanged for favors with the fey. Be warned, they are not obligated to accept it.]
target: [Tessera Amicitiae (Fey): Nummus sigillum Fey gerens. Pro favoribus cum Fey commutari potest. Moneor: non obligantur eam recipere.]

source: “Well, that seems supremely useless…” Sam thought, then with a shrug put the token into his inventory and turned towards the house.
target: “Ita, hoc videtur summopere inutile…” cogitavit Sam; deinde tessera in inventarium suum recondidit atque ad domum se vertit.

source: He had a nice lady to save…
target: Habebat mulierem pulchram ad servandum…
